title: Pill, Drug and Medicine (2/2)
titleZh: Pill、Drug 和 Medicine 的用法 (2/2)
summaryZh: 延續藥物用字的討論，說明藥丸和藥物的差別，以及什麼是處方藥。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Ask a Teacher

sentences.text: Pill is a less general term than drug, medicine, or medication.
sentences.zh: pill 這個字比 drug、medicine 或 medication 更具體，範圍也更小。

sentences.text: We can use it this way to talk about both vitamins and medications.
sentences.zh: 我們可以這樣用它來指維他命，也可以用來指藥品。

sentences.text: Finally, we look at the word drug.
sentences.zh: 最後，我們來看 drug 這個字。

sentences.text: A drug can be a substance in medicine.
sentences.zh: drug 可以是藥品裡的一種成分。

sentences.text: But drugs are also made, sold, and bought for recreational use.
sentences.zh: 但 drug 也可能是為了娛樂用途而製造、販賣和購買的東西。

sentences.text: Some drugs and medicines require a doctor's approval for use.
sentences.zh: 有些藥物和藥品必須經過醫生同意才能使用。

sentences.text: I hope this helps you to understand how to use these words, Zafir.
sentences.zh: Zafir，希望這能幫助你了解這些字怎麼用。

sentences.text: What question do you have about American English?
sentences.zh: 你對美式英語有什麼問題嗎？

sentences.text: Send us an email at learningenglish at voanews.
sentences.zh: 請寄電子郵件到 learningenglish@voanews 給我們。
以上就是本集的〈問老師〉單元。
